imani.name: Dr. Imani Okafor
imani.bio: She collected stories for twenty years. Now she's inside one.
imani.perk: Reads more from every note (reveals an extra clue).

mateo.name: Mateo Salazar
mateo.bio: Knows how to move through bad country quickly.

hana.name: Hana Kobayashi
hana.bio: Grew up around old things that should not be disturbed.
hana.perk: Steady nerves (sanity drains slower). Starts with an ofuda.

rook.name: Ruben 'Rook' Delacroix
rook.bio: Breaks into places no one should enter, quietly.
rook.perk: Very quiet. Starts with spring water.
